title: Confidence worked examples, per meter, N visits and No data
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. These are number and date accuracy cases: enter the exact inputs, read the value the screen shows, and compare it with the value worked out below.
  3. Six test units, (a), (b), (d), (e), (f) and (g).
  4. Seed each unit's reading history by hand (standard steps; Mark complete on a work order records that work order's mileage and engine hours as readings dated its Reset date):
  5. ↳ In Settings > Maintenance (needs Settings Service) create, once, a throwaway schedule "ZZAUTOTEST Reading seed" with one routine service per reading: "ZZ Seed 1", "ZZ Seed 2", "ZZ Seed 3", "ZZ Seed 4", "ZZ Seed 5", "ZZ Seed 6" (calendar Every 12 months each). Enrol each test unit on it in turn (its Maintenance tab > Enroll in Schedule, dates blank).
  6. ↳ For each reading below, oldest first: Work Orders > New Work Order for the unit; type the mileage (and the engine hours, where given) in the work order's Mileage (and Engine Hours) field; on that work order's maintenance card open the next "ZZ Seed" service's row menu > Mark complete > On a work order (this work order) > Reset date = the date given > Mark complete. A Reset date is never in the future.
  7. ↳ Unit (a): ZZ Seed 1 31 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 1 days before today, Mileage 103,000.
  8. ↳ Unit (b): ZZ Seed 1 270 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 240 days before today, Mileage 103,000; ZZ Seed 3 210 days before today, Mileage 106,000; ZZ Seed 4 180 days before today, Mileage 109,000; ZZ Seed 5 150 days before today, Mileage 112,000; ZZ Seed 6 120 days before today, Mileage 115,000.
  9. ↳ Unit (d): ZZ Seed 1 455 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 425 days before today, Mileage 103,000.
  10. ↳ Unit (e): ZZ Seed 1 790 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 760 days before today, Mileage 103,000.
  11. ↳ Unit (f): ZZ Seed 1 130 days before today, Mileage 100,000, Engine Hours 5,000; ZZ Seed 2 100 days before today, Mileage 103,000, Engine Hours 5,150; ZZ Seed 3 70 days before today, Mileage 106,000; ZZ Seed 4 40 days before today, Mileage 109,000; ZZ Seed 5 10 days before today, Mileage 112,000.
  12. ↳ Unit (g): ZZ Seed 1 60 days before today, Mileage 100,000; ZZ Seed 2 57 days before today, Mileage 100,300; ZZ Seed 3 30 days before today, Mileage 103,000.
  13. ↳ After each unit is seeded, remove it from the throwaway schedule (Maintenance tab > schedule menu > Remove from schedule), then enrol it on a schedule with "Oil" (calendar Every 6 months + Distance Every 15,000 mileage), dates blank.
custom_steps:
1. For (a), (b) and (d) read the mileage card's confidence word.
  2. For (e) read the mileage card and Oil's Due cell.
  3. For (f) read the mileage card and the engine-hours card.
  4. For (g) read "Measured from N visits" on the mileage card.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • (a) Medium (one pair, last reading yesterday); (b) Medium (five pairs, last reading 120 days old); (d) Low (last reading about 14 months old).
  • (e) No data: the mileage card offers no estimate, and Oil's Due cell shows its calendar date (the meter offers no date).
  • (f) Each meter grades on its own: mileage High (four pairs, last reading 10 days old), engine hours Low (one pair, last reading 100 days old).
  • (g) "Measured from 2 visits", not 3: the first two readings are 3 days apart, so that pair is discarded and the first visit takes part in no usable pair.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10566 (S9, The asset Maintenance tab), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S9 (Confidence, as the cards show it: S11-R10, S11-R17, S11-R24 to S11-R26, S11-E5, copied from Chunk 2; S11-R4 from Chunk 2 MR, Confluence 897679389); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-E5: “Two visits, the last one yesterday: one pair, under 30 days, Medium. Six visits, five pairs, the last reading 120 days old: Medium ... The same unit fourteen months after its last visit: Low”
  • S11-R26: “A unit whose readings are all older than that reads No data and the calendar governs, as for a unit never read”
  • S11-R10: “Distance and engine hours will each carry their own confidence, computed independently”
  • S11-R24: “Up to 30 days: one pair Medium, two or more High”
  • S11-R24: “91 to 180 days: one pair Low”
  • S11-R25: “Measured from N visits, where a card shows it, counts the readings that took part in at least one usable pair. A visit whose only pairs were discarded does not count”
  • S11-R4 (Chunk 2 MR, Confluence 897679389): “Pairs less than seven days apart will be discarded”
  • S11-R17: “No data is a separate state, not a confidence level”
